data.one_liner: A simple widget wrapper to enable a modal progress hud with a blur effect.
data.what_it_does: It wraps any widget and displays a modal progress indicator over it when an asynchronous call is in progress. Additionally, it applies a customizable blur effect to the background using a BackdropFilter.
use_when: You want to block user interaction and show a loading spinner during async tasks.
You want a blurred backdrop behind your progress indicator.
avoid_when: You need complex state management for your entire loading flow.
You prefer non-modal inline loading indicators.
strengths: Easy to wrap around any widget like a Scaffold.
Customizable blur effect intensity, opacity, color, and progress indicator widget.
weaknesses: Limited to basic modal loading overlay use cases.
